pitch: Wake beneath an unfamiliar sky in a woodland clearing. A weathered sign points toward Thornwall. Explore your surroundings and choose your first steps in the Severed Lands.
title: Rift Awakening

pitch: A broken Guild wagon blocks a forest crossing. Its driver needs help while a hungry Rifthound watches from the treeline.
title: Last Cart Through

pitch: A Rift-touched boar has made a supply trail impassable. Choose your ground before the hunt becomes a charge.
title: The Quarry Turns

pitch: A surveyor hangs below a Cairnfields crossing. Clear the approach, then keep the rescue line intact.
title: Hold the Rope

pitch: A recovered suit of Warden armour wakes during an Athenaeum stocktake. Get the porters out before the storeroom becomes wreckage.
title: Dead Inventory

pitch: A Lodge trainee owes the town an exhibition. Stand in for two friendly bouts and give the audience something worth remembering.
title: The Sparring Debt

pitch: A salvage crew is trapped in a Hollows cellar. Open a way in, then bring them out before the district shifts.
title: No One Left Below

pitch: At a Nexus cartographer's wake, the final chart is missing. A broken cellar latch and a witness's account offer the first leads.
title: The Cartographer’s Wake

pitch: An amber lamp burns upstairs in a townhouse newly returned to the Hollows. A local scavenger asks for help recovering a family keepsake.
title: A Light on Breathing Street

pitch: At a Thornwall forge, two unpaid workers present pay chits and a rough sketch of a counting-house. Decide whether and how to help reclaim their wages.
title: The Honest Thief

pitch: A warning bell fell into an old Warden workhouse after a salvage platform collapsed. Crews offer payment and equipment for its recovery.
title: The Bell Below

pitch: A Guild supply caravan is overdue in the Verdant Margin. At a roadside post, a courier shows its last known trail and offers a rescue contract.
title: The Long Way Round

pitch: As Lodge trainee Tavin Bell, begin beside a missing-relic notice and your signed pledge. Quarterkeeper Ysra asks for a Warden survey plate's return and an honest account.
title: A Debt in Iron

pitch: Two salvage crews claim the same newly returned Hollows storehouse. Rift-touched predators occupy its entrance route, and both crews offer to pay for scouting.
title: The Scavengers’ Accord

pitch: At a Hollows staging yard, a patron offers a paid trial recovery from a newly returned storehouse. Meet available workers and decide how to approach the job.
title: The Company of the Lost

pitch: In a Nexus map room, two charts disagree about a Cairnfields approach. A sponsor offers a survey contract and equipment for checking the route.
title: The Map of Tomorrow
